name: factuarea/factuarea-for-woocommerce
description: Factuarea for WooCommerce - captures the buyer tax identifier at checkout and delivers paid orders and refunds to Factuarea with its own outbox, backoff and idempotency.

scripts.lint:english: php scripts/check-english.php src scripts factuarea-for-woocommerce.php uninstall.php readme.txt README.md docs
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/factuarea-for-woocommerce && rsync -a --exclude-from=.distignore --exclude='.git/' --exclude='dist/' ./ dist/factuarea-for-woocommerce/ && cd dist && zip -rq factuarea-for-woocommerce.zip factuarea-for-woocommerce

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the PHPUnit suites (Unit without a database, Integration against the containerised WordPress database).
scripts-descriptions.lint:phpcs: Runs the WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards over src/, scripts/ and the two plugin root files.
scripts-descriptions.lint:english: Fails when a user-facing string of the package is written in Spanish.
scripts-descriptions.lint:no-paywall: Fails when a feature of the plugin is gated behind a payment, a licence or a plan upgrade, and checks the licence file and the packaged artefact.
scripts-descriptions.lint:tested-up-to: Fails when the declared WordPress and WooCommerce versions contradict each other, and emits the declared tested pair for the revalidation job.
scripts-descriptions.package: Builds dist/factuarea-for-woocommerce.zip exactly as it would be published, honouring .distignore.
scripts-descriptions.verify: Runs test, lint:phpcs, lint:english, lint:no-paywall, lint:tested-up-to and package, in that order.
